# Cosmetic Formulation & Market Analytics Case Study

> **Academic Data Visualization & Business Intelligence Project (Tableau & Power BI)**  
> Department of Computer and Communication Engineering / Honours Coursework Project  
> An analytical investigation into skincare and makeup product formulations, active ingredient concentrations, safety classifications, and consumer market segments.

---

## 1. Overview

This project presents an academic business intelligence and exploratory data analysis case study focusing on the cosmetic and personal care industry. Using structured formulation datasets, the project models relationships between product pricing, category classifications (cleansers, serums, moisturizers, SPF), active ingredients (e.g., Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, Retinoids), and biological benefit profiles.

---

## 2. Artifacts & Deliverables

The repository contains the complete academic project deliverables:

- **`Book11.twb`**: Interactive Tableau Workbook featuring multi-layered dashboards for ingredient distribution, brand tier comparisons, and safety ratings.
- **`book44.pbix`**: Microsoft Power BI Desktop report with dynamic cross-filtering, DAX measures for ingredient frequency, and pricing breakdown matrices.
- **`DV Hnours Mini Project A2- Lokesh.docx`**: Complete academic technical report detailing research questions, data normalization, visual encoding choices, and analytical conclusions.

---

## 3. Key Analytical Insights

1. **Active Ingredient Distribution**: Frequency analysis identifying market penetration of primary active ingredients across mass-market versus premium luxury price tiers.
2. **Category Price Variance**: Statistical box plots and standard deviation measures revealing market markups for specialized active serums relative to standard emollient creams.
3. **Safety & Concentration Compliance**: Correlation matrices tracking ingredient concentrations against dermatological safety reference ranges.

---

## 4. Software & Tools

- **Business Intelligence**: Tableau Desktop, Microsoft Power BI
- **Data Modeling**: Microsoft Excel, DAX Expressions
- **Documentation**: Technical Academic Report
